text:
Maria (Partnerships): heads up 10 we need to rebalance Q2 MDF after the cloud marketplace push + two HW co-sell asks. can we lock allocations before Wed's QBR?
Dan (Finance): ballpark numbers? current utilization by partner tier?
Liam (Sales Ops): short snapshot: Tier A (strategic SI + HW): 65% pipeline coverage; Tier B (marketplace listed): 22%; Tier C: 13%. noticing conversion dip in Tier B since the new listing flow.
Sofia (GTM): plan: move about 20% of Tier C MDF to top 3 SIs and one HW partner that committed to co-marketing and a demo rack. supports a joint announcement and demo infra for marketplace leads.
Ava (Revenue Ops): need scorecard gating first. propose Tier A eligibility = influence >= $250k pipeline (last 90d) OR 3 joint customers closed. otherwise holdback.
Maria (Partnerships): Dan, can finance approve provisional reallocations pending scorecard updates?
Dan (Finance): we can provisionally reallocate up to $150k today. final signoff requires scorecards by EOD Fri. requests >$150k need director approval.
mdf-bot: new MDF request template v2 live 1 use `/mdf request` to file. auto-tags partner tier and last-90d influence. :robot_face:
Liam (Sales Ops): proposed adjustments:
- Top 3 SIs: current $180,000 -> +$90,000
- Strategic HW: current $50,000 -> +$60,000
- Tier B marketplace: current $120,000 -> -$80,000
- Tier C: current $60,000 -> -$70,000
Sofia (GTM): earmark $40k from the increase for a joint announcement pack (press + webinar + co-demos). will ping comms for a quick estimate.
Ava (Revenue Ops): adding `mdf_release` gating column to scorecard (manual vs auto) plus `req_docs` for POs/agreements. will push link into the QBR deck.
Maria (Partnerships): action list: Ava - publish updated scorecard by Fri EOD; Liam - file MDF requests using `/mdf request` and tag approvers; Dan - provisional $150k approval; Sofia - draft joint announcement plan + comms budget.
Dan (Finance): ack. I'll escalate >$150k to director if needed.
Liam (Sales Ops): note: HW partner requested an on-prem boxed demo. if we approve, add $25k to the HW line.
Dan (Finance): treat as conditional pending PO or confirmed co-funding.
Ava (Revenue Ops): will track PO status in `req_docs`.
Maria (Partnerships): adding this to QBR agenda: "Partner ops: MDF rebalancing + joint announcements." QBR slot Wed 10:30 PT confirmed.
Sofia (GTM): thanks team :thumbsup:
